headline: Guard note for fastapi/params.py edits
what_breaks: fastapi/routing.py — relies on Param class for route parameters
fastapi/dependencies/utils.py — uses Param for dependency injection
fastapi/openapi/utils.py — depends on Param for OpenAPI schema generation
why: This file contains the Param class, which is crucial for defining API parameter types and their validation. Changes here can affect routing, dependency injection, and OpenAPI documentation generation across multiple files.
checklist: Review changes to the Param class constructor and its attributes.
Check for any modifications to the ParamTypes Enum.
Ensure compatibility with fastapi/routing.py and fastapi/dependencies/utils.py.
